name: Nurlatief Adhi Jagad
title: Network Engineer
tagline: Designing, operating, and automating reliable enterprise networks.
description: Network Engineer with 4+ years of experience in enterprise network infrastructure, SD-WAN implementation, and network security. Proven track record managing large-scale government and enterprise networks — from operating 10,000+ devices to migrating 300+ branch sites to SD-WAN.

about.bio: Network Engineer with 4+ years of progressive experience in enterprise network infrastructure, SD-WAN implementation, and network security. Proven track record achieving 99.8% network uptime and migrating traditional WAN to SD-WAN across 300+ branch sites. Experienced handling large-scale government and enterprise networks with Cisco, Fortinet, Huawei, and Palo Alto ecosystems.

experience.description: Managing end-to-end network requirements for Diskominfo Jawa Barat as a key government customer — covering network provisioning, configuration management, and ongoing support to ensure reliable connectivity for public sector digital services.
responsibilities: Executed migration of workloads from Disaster Recovery (DR) to Disaster Recovery Center (DRC) environment with zero unplanned downtime.
Configured and managed NAT policies (DNAT/SNAT) on Palo Alto NGFW for multi-tenant Data Center environments.
Deployed WAF policies and custom signatures to protect customer-facing web services.
Implemented Security Groups within VPC environments for micro-segmentation aligned with zero-trust principles.
Provisioned VMs in cloud infrastructure including network interface binding and routing table assignment.
Configured L2/L3 switching and routing for Data Center interconnection (VLAN segmentation, inter-VLAN routing, dynamic routing).

experience.description: Advanced network troubleshooting and root cause analysis for router and security incidents across all regional networks.
responsibilities: Resolved 50+ network incidents per month with an average MTTR < 30 minutes.
Maintained 99% network uptime across enterprise router and firewall infrastructure.
Monitored network performance with Zabbix and centralized syslog via SIEM platforms.
Delivered network services for PLN, Pertamina, ministries, Diskominfo, Dirjenpas, and BRIN.
Engineered BGP transit peering for IX and IIX exchange connectivity.
Managed 10,000+ router and firewall devices across government and enterprise networks.
Implemented Metro Ethernet and Cloud IP VPN services for banking and retail customers.

experience.description: Migrated network devices from traditional WAN to SD-WAN technology to improve customer network efficiency, flexibility, and cost-effectiveness.
responsibilities: Led migration of 50+ enterprise branch offices to Fortinet SD-WAN architecture.
Participated in large-scale SD-WAN deployment across 300+ branch sites.
Managed multi-vendor SD-WAN devices across Cisco, FortiGate, and Huawei platforms.
Compiled comprehensive network topology documentation for customer SD-WAN deployments.

experience.description: Collaborated with cross-functional teams to improve wired and wireless network infrastructure, achieving uptime of up to 99.8%.
responsibilities: Provided high-quality first and second level escalation support for networks and telecommunications.
Performed troubleshooting and resolved network issues quickly to minimize downtime.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to enhance wired and wireless infrastructure.

projects.name: SD-WAN Migration — 300+ Branch Sites
projects.description: Large-scale migration from traditional WAN to Fortinet SD-WAN architecture across 300+ enterprise branch sites.
projects.problem: Traditional WAN was inflexible, costly, and difficult to scale for multi-site requirements.
projects.solution: Deployed Fortinet SD-WAN with centralized routing, failover, and application-aware traffic steering.
projects.result: Improved WAN resilience, application performance, and cost optimization across 300+ sites.

projects.name: Multi-Tenant DC Network Security
projects.description: NAT and WAF policy configuration on Palo Alto NGFW for a multi-tenant Data Center environment.
projects.problem: Required segmentation and security compliance in a shared multi-tenant environment.
projects.solution: Implemented DNAT/SNAT policies, WAF custom signatures, and VPC security groups for micro-segmentation.
projects.result: Applied zero-trust network principles; customer-facing services protected.

projects.name: DR to DRC Workload Migration
projects.description: Migration of workloads from Disaster Recovery to Disaster Recovery Center environment.
projects.problem: Business continuity plan required controlled failover with no downtime.
projects.solution: Executed planned failover event with cross-team coordination to ensure resource availability.
projects.result: Zero unplanned downtime throughout the migration.

projects.name: Government & Enterprise Network Operations
projects.description: Operations of network services for large government and enterprise institutions.
projects.problem: High availability and security requirements for public digital services.
projects.solution: End-to-end lifecycle management: implementation, monitoring, operations, and troubleshooting.
projects.result: 99% uptime, MTTR < 30 minutes across 50+ incidents per month.

projects.name: BGP Transit Peering Optimization
projects.description: Engineering BGP transit peering for IX and IIX connectivity.
projects.problem: Route path optimization for performance and transit cost efficiency.
projects.solution: Configured BGP peering with IX and IIX exchanges.
projects.result: Optimized routing paths and reduced transit costs.

projects.name: 10K+ Device Fleet Management
projects.description: Management of 10,000+ router and firewall devices across government and enterprise networks.
projects.problem: Large-scale device fleet required stability and operational efficiency.
projects.solution: Proactive monitoring, incident response, preventive maintenance, and OS/firmware lifecycle management.
projects.result: Maintained 99% uptime across a 10,000+ device fleet.
